post.description:
OAuth2 Login
The client needs to first hash the password using SHA256 before transmitting it.
Log in with the OpenAccount account, and a token that allows access to the open-api service and web-api service will be returned. 
When accessing the open-api service, the parameter 'Authorization' needs to be added to the request header, and the value should be in the format of "Bearer + the returned token".
For example: Bearer 40c28166946f366741c06e47b4f3729e
When accessing the web-api service, you need to add the parameter 'token' to the request header, with the value being the returned token only.
OAuth2 登录
客户端需先对密码进行 SHA256 哈希后再传输
用OpenAccount账号登录，返回可访问open-api服务和web-api服务的token，
访问open-api服务时，需要在请求头上面添加参数'Authorization'，值的格式为Bearer +返回的token
例如：Bearer 40c28166946f366741c06e47b4f3729e
访问web-api服务时，需要在请求头上面添加参数'token'，值的格式为返回的token即可
